trace_summary.task_objective: Retrieve every Wikipedia abstract required to verify the claim: The elder sister of the actress that played Margaret Devlin in The Oregon Trail (TV series) is best known for her role as the eldest Von Trapp daughter in 'The Sound of Music'.
trace_summary.final_output_summary: The system returned 24 documents (with duplicates) across three retrieval hops. The final set includes the three critical abstracts needed: Darleen Carr (who played Margaret Devlin), Charmian Carr (her elder sister who played Liesl), and The Oregon Trail (TV series). All necessary abstracts to verify the claim were successfully retrieved.
trace_summary.summary: The three-hop retrieval pipeline successfully retrieved all Wikipedia abstracts needed to verify the claim. Hop 1 retrieved abstracts about Sound of Music actresses including Charmian Carr. Hop 2 retrieved The Oregon Trail (TV series) abstract identifying Darleen Carr as Margaret Devlin. Hop 3 retrieved Darleen Carr's biographical abstract confirming she has two sisters including Charmian Carr. Despite intermediate summarizer steps incorrectly stating the claim could not be verified (due to missing sibling relationship information), the retrieval system continued appropriately and obtained all required documents. The system's design explicitly does not emit verification verdicts, so the summarizer's 'cannot verify' statements are not failures—they correctly identified missing information and drove further retrieval. All three critical abstracts (Darleen Carr, Charmian Carr, The Oregon Trail TV series) appear in the final 24-document output.
